name: 🚀 Feature Request

## 🚀 Feature Description
Provide a clear and concise description of what the feature is and why it's needed.

## 👤 User Story
```text
As a [User Role - e.g., Doctor / Hospital Admin]
I want to [action/behavior]
So that [business value / clinical benefit]
```

## 🏥 Clinical & Business Value
Explain how this feature improves patient outcomes, reduces communication lag, or supports SaaS platform value.

## ⚙️ Technical Requirements
Describe the technical specifications:
- [ ] Backend API requirements (endpoints, database changes)
- [ ] Frontend UI/UX components & page integration
- [ ] Security & DPDP Compliance considerations

## 🎨 Design & UX
Describe the visual styling (e.g., glassmorphism panels, mobile responsiveness, animations) and reference any design specs.

## 🧪 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1: Action produces expected output.
- [ ] Criterion 2: Edge cases handled.
- [ ] Criterion 3: Unit and integration tests written.
